name: Miguel
source:
Adam's fastidious creator. He's the head of the mansion where Adam lives. He may sound rude and pompous, but he has a good heart.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1742500/My_Dear_Frankenstein_English_Edition/]Steam[/url]]
